cover.hook: Ottawa matched Ontario's $1B for Ring of Fire roads. $2B locked in.
cover.sub: Plus the AI agent that monitors your business — but not in Canada yet — and two funding deadlines you need.

reelSub: Five AI and funding moves NWO can't ignore this week.
storySub: What this week's AI and funding news means for a Northwestern Ontario business.

items.title: Ottawa matches Ontario's $1B for Ring of Fire roads
items.body: Carney and Ford committed $1B federal on October 21, matching Ontario's billion, as part of an $8.7B joint package. Roads connect the provincial highway system to the Ring of Fire — 500 km north of Thunder Bay. Construction already 5 years ahead of schedule.
items.tease: Next: $4.9M for 17 NWO communities to build economic capacity.
items.reelLine: Ottawa matched Ontario's $1B for Ring of Fire roads — $2B total locked in.

items.title: FedNor sends $4.9M to 17 NWO communities for economic development officers
items.body: FedNor's Community Investment Initiative put $4,907,925 into 17 municipalities and First Nation communities to hire EDOs for three years. Ring of Fire and mining named as priority sectors. Mushkegowuk Council gets $504,900 for two officers.
items.tease: Next: the AI agent that monitors your inbox — but not from Canada.
items.reelLine: FedNor put $4.9M into 17 NWO communities for economic development capacity.

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Duet monitors your business in the background — US only
items.body: Anthropic previewed Claude Duet on October 21: a proactive agent on Opus 5.5 that monitors QuickBooks, Stripe, HubSpot and 6,000+ more, sends daily briefings, and asks approval before payments or messages. US waitlist only — no Canadian launch date confirmed.
items.reelLine: Anthropic launched Claude Duet — a proactive AI agent — US only for now.

items.title: NOHFC Invest North Grow intake closes in 5 days
items.body: Round 3 deadline is October 31. Up to $400K in grants, up to $1M with a term loan, for capital, equipment, and ICT projects in Northern Ontario. A complete business plan is required. Next window: January 31.
items.tease: Next: Gemini's price jump you need to know before December.
items.reelLine: NOHFC Invest North Grow intake closes October 31 — five days left.

items.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon API pricing doubles on December 1
items.body: Confirmed on Google's official pricing page: $2 input and $10 output per 1M tokens becomes $4 and $20 on December 1. All paid tiers — Standard, Batch, Flex, Priority — double at once. Recalculate now if you have Gemini 4 Argon in a product.
items.reelLine: Google's Gemini 4 Argon API pricing doubles December 1 — check your usage now.

summary.title: Infrastructure locks in, AI agents arrive, and two deadlines loom
summary.body: Ottawa committed $2B combined with Ontario for Ring of Fire roads while FedNor built community capacity across 17 NWO communities — all as Anthropic launched its most capable AI agent product yet, Canada-excluded for now, and two funding clocks ran toward their limits.
